surfaces.A_directory: Always available under 'Find your solution' — card = positioning line + who it's for, grouped by problem, not by company
surfaces.B_featured: Full solution block shown when the visitor's domain, ad entry, or firmographics match — presented conversationally by the agent
surfaces.C_snapshot: Snapshot modules framed as capabilities; 'powered by' credit revealed at the routing step, not before
surfaces.D_cross_discovery: 'Teams solving this usually also ask about…' — shown after the primary match is established

solutions.name: QuestBrand
solutions.positioning: Know how your brand is really doing — every day. Always-on tracking of awareness, consideration and momentum, benchmarked against the competitors you name. Watch a campaign move the numbers, as a subscription — not a quarterly research project.
solutions.shownWhen: B: domain=brand_health · C: powers competitive & brand modules · D: after Numetrix (retail) and BERA conversations · industry boost QSR/retail/CPG

solutions.name: QuestDIY
solutions.positioning: Run real consumer research yourself — in days. Describe what you want to learn; AI helps draft the questionnaire, fields it to respondents in 100+ countries, and helps you read the results. No agency required.
solutions.whoFor: Teams that need answers before the deadline
solutions.shownWhen: B: domain=research; Q6 one-off · D: to brand-health visitors needing a deep-dive; wherever 'test creative/messaging' appears

solutions.name: BERA.ai
solutions.positioning: Prove the brand is moving the business. Continuous scoring of the emotional and functional drivers of brand strength, connected to pricing power, revenue and market value — so you know which brand investments pay, and which audiences to grow.
solutions.shownWhen: B: domain=business_impact; Q6 board/CFO · D: enterprise brand-health visitors; every consultative recap · role boost C-suite

solutions.name: Unlock
solutions.positioning: Real, verified people behind every answer. A global respondent supply and identity backbone — validated consumer and B2B respondents, so your research stands on sample you can trust.
solutions.whoFor: The quality layer under our research offerings
solutions.shownWhen: Supporting role by design: trust layer on research pages; standalone B only for agency/research buyers asking about sample quality

solutions.name: The Knowledge Machine (Pulse)
solutions.positioning: See the story before it breaks. Instead of counting mentions, it reads narrative alignment and emotional intensity — and flags the risks that are about to become headlines.
solutions.whoFor: Communications chiefs who'd rather prevent than respond
solutions.shownWhen: B: domain=reputation; Q6 early-warning/one market · industry boost pharma/finance/insurance/energy/gov · D: beside UNICEPTA when both fit

solutions.name: UNICEPTA
solutions.positioning: Everything said about you, everywhere, in every language. Human-plus-AI monitoring of news, social and broadcast worldwide, with analysis of the narratives your stakeholders are forming.
solutions.shownWhen: B: domain=reputation; Q6 global/multi-language · firmographic boost multinational/Europe · D: beside The Knowledge Machine

solutions.name: IMAI
solutions.positioning: Influencer programs, end to end. Hundreds of millions of creator profiles — discovery, vetting and fraud checks, then outreach, contracts, approvals and tracking through to ROI. One tool instead of spreadsheets and DMs.
solutions.shownWhen: B: domain=influencer AND tier mid/enterprise (Q6 creators ≥ ~100); SMB sees the SMB platform instead · D: where creator language appears

solutions.name: Stagwell AI for SMBs
solutions.positioning: Discover creators, validate audience quality, and prove ROI — without a big team or budget. Listen, understand, execute, and measure, all from one dashboard.

solutions.name: GEOPulse
solutions.positioning: When AI answers, is it recommending you? Track how ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mention, describe and recommend your brand versus rivals — and what to change to show up more.
solutions.shownWhen: C first: its output IS the snapshot's AI-visibility module · B: domain=ai_visibility · D: universal companion

solutions.name: The Targeting Machine
solutions.positioning: Your data. Your audiences. No walled garden. Fuse your first-party data with third-party media data and proprietary consumer intelligence, build custom audiences, and activate them straight into your buying.
solutions.whoFor: Media and analytics leaders who want control back
solutions.shownWhen: B: domain=audiences · campaign product — its ad traffic lands on the product-branded page · D: where wasted-spend/targeting language appears

solutions.name: Numetrix
solutions.positioning: What people do, not what they tell surveys. Real-world behavior measurement — who actually visited, how foot traffic moved, and whether your advertising changed where people went.
solutions.shownWhen: B: domain=real_world_behavior · firmographic trigger: retail/QSR/venue footprint detected — offered even unasked · D: say/do companion to brand tracking and targeting

solutions.name: Stagwell's Machines (family frame)
solutions.positioning: One family of machines, one operating system for marketing. The Machine connects your tools, audiences, insights and campaigns into an agentic system that keeps learning — with specialized machines for media, knowledge and targeting.
solutions.shownWhen: B: domain=marketing_ops; enterprise firmographics · frame around every multi-product consultative recap
